questions.question_text: What is the recommended time to arrive before an interview to show punctuality and preparedness?

options.text: Right on time, to avoid waiting around
5 minutes early, to keep things casual
10-15 minutes early, to account for unexpected delays
30 minutes early, to make a strong impression

correct_answer.text: 10-15 minutes early, to account for unexpected delays

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a key element of making a strong first impression during an interview?

options.text: Checking your phone to stay updated
Smiling, making eye contact, and offering a firm handshake (if in-person)
Talking about your personal hobbies right away
Sitting with crossed arms to appear relaxed

correct_answer.text: Smiling, making eye contact, and offering a firm handshake (if in-person)

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of sending a thank-you note or email after an interview?

options.text: To ask immediately if you got the position
To show gratitude, keep yourself memorable, and reinforce your interest
To explain any mistakes you made during the interview
To request feedback on how you performed

correct_answer.text: To show gratitude, keep yourself memorable, and reinforce your interest

questions.question_text: When reflecting on your interview performance, what is a helpful strategy to improve for future interviews?

options.text: Focus only on what went wrong to avoid repeating mistakes
Ignore the experience if you don’t get the opportunity
Jot down what went well, what was tricky, and how you can improve
Wait for the interviewer to give you feedback before reflecting

correct_answer.text: Jot down what went well, what was tricky, and how you can improve
